## Load libraries and data

```{r}
library("tidyverse")

cancer_data_augmented <- read_csv(file = "../data/03_cancer_data_augmented.csv", 
                        show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Cause of death by treatment

```{r}
cancer_data_d1 <- cancer_data_augmented |>
  drop_na(death_cause) |> 
  count(estrogen_treatment, death_cause)
  
  ggplot(cancer_data_d1,
         aes(x = estrogen_treatment, 
             y = n,
             fill = death_cause)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill")
```
